selectionMethod: All 52 moduleResolution conformance inputs plus named compiler fixtures covering paths inheritance, symlinks, suffixes, noDts, automatic types, package IDs and explicit usage modes.

rules.source: Keep source/config/file bytes unchanged within each selected variant, document environment/API-mode adapters explicitly.
rules.mode: Do not silently convert removed Classic/Node10 expectations to Node16/Bundler.
rules.claim: A resolver-only adaptation is not a full original compiler test pass.
rules.order: Source search/trace sequences exact; unordered table/set rows sorted only by meaningful canonical keys.
